List the people and companies that hold at least one currently
effective power of attorney, drawn from the most recent Company
Verification report registered for the entity.

This is a simplified projection of the report's found entities: each
row carries only the holder's identity and their current powers — no
cap-table holdings, share totals, or ownership percentages. Holders
whose powers have all expired, and pure shareholders with no powers,
